additional_info.subject: ID0371847-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N0 160382417] Display not working CRM:00642001380
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing good.
As per reported issue by end customer, the terminal screen was
black, please
follow this action from your side it will help you to solve the
problem.
1.Please reboot the charger.
2.You will need to change the DP cable. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers, R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Also,
kindly check if LED strips is faulty or
not.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0371847 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
DE
